description: Motion Fab's published community recipes: short videos people made, each with the prompt that makes one like it. Without `query` the newest first; with it, recipes whose English title or prompt has those words. Each has its id, slug, title, one-sentence summary, the Motion Fab template it was made with, tags, the AI model, the original author when it rebuilds someone else's video (`credit`: name, X handle, their post), its page on motionfab.app, its video and how often it was used. The prompt and the techniques come with get_recipe.

lang.description: The language of titles and summaries; default en.

query.description: English words, such as "neon logo reveal".

template.description: A Motion Fab template id, such as simple-motion.

name: search_recipes
title: Search recipes
